stats.label: Professionals the new centre can house
Earmarked for an AI data centre

diaspora_bullets: US-headquartered firm has operated in Hyderabad since 2014
Centre inaugurated by Telangana IT Minister D. Sridhar Babu
news_summary: SplashBI, a Georgia, US-headquartered enterprise data intelligence company, has opened a Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad and plans to invest more than $100 million over the next five to seven years.
payoff: Its teams will work on platform engineering, AI and data science.
